reasons: CS3213 is only offered in Sem 2, but the student requires it in Y4S2 (Sem 8).

CS4240 requires CS3240, which requires CS2111 or NM2207. CS2111 is only offered in Sem 2, and NM2207 is only offered in Sem 2. Taking these in Sem 2 or later makes it impossible to fit CS3240 and CS4240 before Sem 8 while also fitting CS2102 and CS2109S which require CS2030S/CS2040S.
Even if prerequisites were met, CS3213 cannot be taken in Sem 8 as it is not offered in Sem 1.
